reviews.t: Rusty Trimmer Blade
reviews.x: I've got a rusty blade as attached photo. It is not lining up well. Normal trimmer.

reviews.t: I recommend spending $20 on a trimmer that has a rechargeable battery or cord.
reviews.x: This is the second G-Whiz I’ve bought, the first one being bought February, 2016. The first G-Whiz lasted almost two years, but the motor on this one is already giving out, and I’ve only used it five months. I loved the first G-Whiz I bought, but this is the last one I will purchase. They’ve also gone up in price quite a bit since the first time I bought them, and the price continues to climb.

reviews.t: Dead right out of the box.
reviews.x: Looked good in the package.  It is a small trimmer. I own a few trimmers Wahl and Andis brands and they have all worked out the box.  I replaced the included panasonic battery with a brand new Duracell copper top. It started up strong. Turned it off. Then turned it on to use. Hasn't come back on since. Literally 10 minutes from it being delivered . Pretty sad if you ask me. Come on WAHL! Quality control nedds a little more improvement.

reviews.t: Strong set of clippers for shaving considering running on 1 Battery.
reviews.x: Good convenient set of clippers. I would recommend getting a battery charger with this set of clippers because it swallows battery power like no other. But because it's a cordless battery operated set of clippers you never have to worry about frying these. I zero gapped mine and oiled em up and they work as advertised!

reviews.t: Very bad store
reviews.x: Very bad I buy black colour and this.... Not good store

reviews.t: Don’t let the price fool you, best trimmers I’ve purchased to date!
reviews.x: These are awesome lil trimmers! I’m a hairstylist that does a lot of clipper cutting and I use these many times per day; my only complaint is they really eat up batteries 😢 though being cordless is so helpful it’s worth it IMO. but they’re light weight, fairly quiet, precise enough for a line up, but won’t cut a wiggly child’s ear either. I’m very impressed with these and they’re an excellent value! Cutting ability that rivals my go to $75 pair (also wahls) lol

reviews.t: It is not the most powerful clipper that I have used and it has struggled a bit on the hair on my head (black dude hair)
reviews.x: Initially I was skeptical about ordering this thing and when it came I was even a bit more dubious given how small it was. That said, my fears were set aside once I started to use it. Let me be upfront. It is not the most powerful clipper that I have used and it has struggled a bit on the hair on my head (black dude hair) which I shave down to the lowest setting (which is pretty damn low with this thing) but it does get the job done! I also use it to shape my bushy beard (I DO NOT shave the bear

reviews.t: Great Little Trimmer
reviews.x: I have the older version of this trimmer that has served me well for many years.  They are identical except for color.  I ordered a new blade and it is like brand new.  I came across this G-Whiz and decided to order it also.  This is a great little trimmer and I like it better than any I've used.  The "T" trimmer blade makes it easy to get into places that a straight blade trimmer cannot.  It is light weight and very comfortable in the hand.  It has plenty of power and a decent battery l

reviews.t: Amazing
reviews.x: This trimmer is amazing its compact battery powered and packs a punch. I use my trimmer to style my beard i havent even adjusted the blades yet and the cut is nice. might i say out of all the cordless clipper options this is by far the best one i have come across especially for the price. This may not be your local barbers best choice but an average joe who trims his own facial hair will feel like a pro with this. If your considering cordless and are unsure and price is an option choose this one

reviews.t: Make sure you don't get a dud.
reviews.x: I have purchased two of these the first one was great and I dropped it and messed it up. I purchased another and it was a dud; no matter how many new batteries I put in it, when you turned it upside down it would lose power. I am going to purchase the Wahl Hero and see how that works.

reviews.t: ... purchased Wahl products in the past and have been satisfied but, this time I received a lemon
reviews.x: I have purchased Wahl products in the past and have been satisfied but, this time I received a lemon . The on/off switch malfunctioned and the trimmer can't run because of it . I had to return the product to Amazon .

reviews.t: And cordless makes it accessible I would recommend getting Andis slim line pro Li and zero gapping ...
reviews.x: They are not hitters. If you are looking for sharp liners these are not the ones you want but if you have sensitive facial hair they cut well enough without scaring or irritating the skin. So they have a purpose for me. And cordless makes it accessible I would recommend getting Andis slim line pro Li and zero gapping for better performance.

reviews.t: Excellent but batteries?
reviews.x: This is a great set of trimmers.  Use them for my beard and can tighten everything up in just a few moments.  Would be nice if it was rechargeable though.  Advertised for "on the go" but make sure to pack a spare AA!  Paying hotel prices for batteries mid-shave is unpleasant.

reviews.t: Professional use.
reviews.x: The battery last a good amount of time and the trimmer cuts close and holds up, I use these to line up my clients all day long and have no issues I do oil them a few times through the day. Would also be good for lining up a beard.

reviews.t: Great when it worked.......Didnt use much wont work
reviews.x: I only use once  a week to clean my beard and new batteries i have to hit the trimmer a few times to get it to start wont start without a helping hand had it since May 2015 until now thinking about getting a different brand

reviews.t: Good trimmer but gotta keep changing the battery too quick.
reviews.x: It don't last long after you put a new battery in it. I go through a lot of batteries with these trimmers, besides that I like them, they feel good in my hand,  and they cut good.

reviews.t: A piece of junk!!!
reviews.x: This quit working after only 2 months, and I only used it 3 TIMES!!!!  I'm sad to say that there seems to be no way to return this after a 30 day window!  What a rip off!

reviews.t: Cuts close to the head which is nice but it drains batteries very quickly and and it ...
reviews.x: Cuts close to the head which is nice but it drains batteries very quickly and and it has begun to pull at my hair while cutting. I would not buy this again.

reviews.t: The only product to be able to shave my neck without nicks or pulling
reviews.x: Great brand named product for the money. I have tried several different brands for the same or more money and they all ineffective and stopped running.

reviews.t: Poor experience
reviews.x: Poor quality product. Poor experience with seller who refused to give full refund. Bad experience overall. Waste of time/money.

reviews.t: It gives a pretty close shave
reviews.x: It gives a pretty close shave, but eats through batteries like crazy. Wouldn't recommend it.

reviews.t: very good, precise
reviews.x: make sure to oil your clippers! very good, precise, feel like a barber using this thing.

claims.text: Many reviewers find these trimmers effective and good value, especially for light trimming and beard styling.
Several reviewers warn that the trimmers drain batteries quickly, though the cordless design is still appreciated.
Some reviewers report durability and quality problems, including motors failing, units dead out of the box, and malfunctioning switches.
A few reviewers note the trimmers are not very powerful and may struggle with thicker hair.
Some reviewers describe receiving defective or damaged units, such as a rusty blade or a dud.
